versions.changelog:
- Major update: skill now focuses on querying specific Kubernetes resources in Huawei Cloud CCE clusters via kubectl cce, with installation only as a prerequisite recovery step.
- Adds strict safeguards: resource queries are strictly read-only (get/describe/logs); wildcards and cluster-wide lists are disallowed.
- Installation and repair of kubectl/kubectl-cce only occur when prerequisites are missing; requires explicit user confirmation.
- Clarifies required parameters for each query: cluster_id, region, resource kind, and namespace or exact name.
- Updates documentation and removes generalized installation and troubleshooting instructions now covered in separate reference files.
- Improves risk management and output requirements for all actions.

- Initial release of the huawei-cloud-kubectl-cce-installer skill.
- Installs, upgrades, verifies, or troubleshoots local kubectl and the Huawei Cloud kubectl-cce plugin for CCE resource access.
- Provides a safe, plan-and-confirm workflow: shows what will change before installing or modifying local binaries.
- Supports Linux/macOS automatic installation with fallback to official or source-built binaries, and manual guidance for Windows users.
- Requires explicit user confirmation for any system changes; never overwrites existing binaries or handles credentials.
